verdict.rationale: Pika's own pages say it generates short clips up to 30-second multi-shot videos and can turn a premise into a film. It also ships several tools for iterating on an existing clip instead of regenerating it: extending it, swapping or adding elements, reshooting from a new angle, relighting, and trimming. Missing for 10: an explicit text-prompt-to-video description beyond marketing one-liners, documentation of a prompt-refinement or versioning workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
